title: Announcing Great Question's $13M Series A Led by Inovia
summary: Great Question has raised $13 million in Series A funding, led by Inovia Capital, to put high-quality research in every team's hands.
body_markdown:
Today, we're proud, and honestly, a little in awe to share that Great Question has raised $13 million USD in Series A funding, led by[Inovia Capital](https://www.inovia.vc/) .


It's an important milestone for our team, but more importantly, it's fuel for the next stage of our mission: making high-quality research accessible to every team in an organization, not just professional researchers.


## Why we started Great Question


When we started Great Question, we'd both felt the same pain again and again: customer insights were buried in decks no one read, trapped in tools no one used, or held by a handful of researchers trying to support hundreds of people across dozens of teams.


We believed there was a better way. One where research wasn't a bottleneck or a black box, but something everyone could participate in.


That belief became our north star.


We're building a world where research isn't a department, it's a habit. Every team should be able to talk to customers, test ideas, and make decisions grounded in customer truth.


Today, we're trusted by leading enterprises like[ServiceNow](https://www.servicenow.com/) ,[Brex](https://www.brex.com/) ,[Canva](https://www.canva.com/) , and[Asana](https://asana.com/) , along with hundreds of growing teams who use Great Question to integrate research into their everyday decisions.


They're proving what happens when research becomes part of company culture: faster learning, smarter decisions, and products that reflect what customers actually need.


## Where we're headed next


Research democratization is no longer a buzzword. It's the next major shift in how enterprises build products and make decisions.


This raise gives us the resources to accelerate that shift.


Over the coming months, we'll focus on:


-


**Expanding research access** so every team can run high-quality studies with built-in guardrails.


-


**AI-driven study creation** that designs new research automatically from existing insights.


-


**AI moderation & validation** that helps teams test ideas quickly and maintain participant authenticity.


-


**Agentic research** : a future where studies run themselves, and insights proactively reach the people who need them.


-


**Growing our global team** across product, engineering, marketing, and customer success to support more enterprises on this journey.


Enterprises don't need more tools; they need more insight. Democratization isn't about giving everyone access; it's about giving everyone understanding.


We believe that's where research is heading. Toward a future where curiosity, not hierarchy, drives discovery.


## A few words from the people who believe in this mission


> “Great Question is the only truly end-to-end research platform built with enterprise-grade governance in mind. The product is built with an emphasis on research democratization, addressing core industry challenges like siloed insights and UXR capacity constraints, positioning them for scalable growth. We're proud to support their mission to embed research into every part of product design.”


Kory Jeffrey


Principal & Vice President, Technology, Inovia Capital


> “Great Question has been instrumental in democratizing our user research practice. It's enabled our team to scale customer conversations without scaling a massive user research team, and it's really changed how we operate.”


Jon Dobrowolski


Product Leader, Core Experiences, Asana


## What comes next


This raise isn't an endpoint, it's a launchpad.


We're just getting started on building a world where every decision starts with a great question, and where research isn't limited by role, team, or title.


To our team, thank you for your relentless curiosity and care.


To our customers, thank you for trusting us to power your work.


And to our investors including[Inovia](https://www.inovia.vc/) ,[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/) ,[January Capital](https://www.january.capital/) , and[Character VC](https://www.character.vc/) , thank you for believing in what we're building.


Here's to the next chapter of research democratization.


[Read the official announcement](https://www.greatquestion.com/blog/great-question-secures-13m-series-a-funding-from-inovia)
